name: Lemon Chicken and Potatoes
summary: Bone-in chicken thighs roasted over potatoes with garlic and lemon.

ingredients.name: dried oregano, plus salt and pepper

instructions: Toss the potatoes and onion with the oil, garlic, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper in a roasting pan.
Nestle the chicken thighs on top, skin-side up, and season the skin with salt.
Roast 45 minutes, until the chicken reaches 74°C (165°F) and the potatoes are tender and golden.
Rest 5 minutes, then serve with the pan juices spooned over.
budgetNotes: Bone-in skin-on thighs are far cheaper than boneless and stay juicy while roasting.
The potatoes cook in the chicken fat — do not skip them.
A cheap lemon or a splash of bottled lemon juice does the job.

pricingMetadata.notes: Prices verified at Ottawa No Frills, September 2026. Bone-in skin-on chicken thighs $8.82/kg (1.2kg = $10.58). Russet potatoes $0.66/kg (900g = $0.59). Onion $1.07 each. Garlic $0.08/clove. Oil $0.42/100mL. Lemon ~$0.50 (estimate).
